for: the 23 Nov audit (scheduled task 'Audit the reverse-engineering pass (fresh agent)')
how_to_grade: A separate grader: an agent that did not build Ananta and did not ask the questions grades the answers blind, against a ground-truth sheet built on the day from the running system (files, database, endpoints, launchd), not from memory.
Each answer gets: right / partly / wrong / wrong route (answered a different question) / refused, plus one line of why and the evidence path.

Compare with the two earlier runs: the 3 Nov independent audit (34 findings: 10 high, 12 medium, 12 low; docs/repair_shop/audit/2026-11-03-independent.md) and the 5 Nov self-knowledge audit (claude/review-2026-11-05-self-knowledge-audit.md in the project; answers in ~/ananta_runs/audit_selfknow/answers_after*.json).

India questions: dry run in a throwaway folder (~/ananta_runs/audit_ask.py or the runner pattern in /tmp/audit1103/run.py with LIVE_OVERRIDE for the other moments); crypto questions: source='eval' (nothing saved). Voice on for India.
The 73 India questions of 3 Nov are asked at the same moments as then: the real moment (about 9:25 pm Toronto, before and just after the 9:30 pm job) and the five 'as if' moments listed per block.
